詞／曲：長澤崇史
中譯詞：孫瑞恩、周巽光

lines.a: 喔主 祢是我們的太陽
lines.b: Oh Lord, You are our sun

lines.a: 滿有慈愛憐憫恩惠榮光
lines.b: Full of love, mercy, grace, and glory

lines.a: 那些全心跟隨祢旨意 屬於祢的百姓
lines.b: Those who wholeheartedly follow Your will and belong to You

lines.a: 因祢恩典 得美好獎賞
lines.b: Will receive a beautiful reward by Your grace

lines.a: 喔主 祢是我們救贖主
lines.b: Oh Lord, You are our Redeemer

lines.a: 祢的仁義公平 掌權在這地
lines.b: Your righteousness and justice rule over this land

lines.a: 祢將祢的榮耀 傾倒在祢大能百姓
lines.b: You pour down Your glory upon Your mighty people
Causing us to stand in awe and reverence of You alone

lines.a: 在天上 配得所有尊崇
lines.b: In heaven, You are worthy of all praise and honor

lines.a: 主祢的榮耀 臨到全地上
lines.b: Your glory descends upon the whole earth

lines.a: 在黑暗中照亮 祢是世界的真光
lines.b: Shining brightly in the darkness, You are the true light of the world

lines.a: 是永遠都不會 下沉的太陽
lines.b: The sun that will never set

lines.a: 來頌揚 主祢至聖尊名
lines.b: We praise Your holy and precious name

lines.a: 高舉全地上 萬民都歌唱
lines.b: Lifting You high across the earth as all nations sing

lines.a: 我們不再悲傷 因祢是唯一盼望
lines.b: We are no longer sorrowful, for You are our only hope

lines.a: 我們同心宣揚 耶穌祢是永遠的真光
lines.b: Together we proclaim, Jesus, You are the everlasting true light

lines.a: 我們不再悲傷 因祢是唯一盼望
lines.b: We are no longer sorrowful, for You are our only hope

lines.a: 我們同心宣揚 耶穌祢是永遠的真光
lines.b: Together we proclaim, Jesus, You are the everlasting true light
